nhve01.title: Aries' holidays
nhve01.caption: Aries in 2016 opened every gift by 5 AM, including the ones with someone else's name on them. Aries in 2026 sits on its hands and lets you go first. Growth looks like vibrating quietly.

nhve02.title: Taurus' holidays
nhve02.caption: 2016 Taurus guarded the cookie plate under a blanket. 2026 Taurus bakes a whole tray for your family first, and one spare, obviously. Who in your life is a cookie hoarder turned cookie sharer?

nhve03.title: Gemini's holidays
nhve03.caption: Three parties, one night, zero real conversations. Then Gemini found one couch and one person and the clock just kept jumping. Are you a three-parties person or a five-more-minutes person?

nhve04.title: Cancer's holidays
nhve04.caption: Cancer cooked for twenty and nobody asked how Cancer was doing. This year someone took the spoon and asked first. Tag the friend who always hosts and never sits down.

nhve05.title: Leo's holidays
nhve05.caption: 2016 Leo spelled its own name in lights and blinded the whole street. 2026 Leo turns the spotlight around and points it at you. Still bright, just better aimed.

nhve06.title: Virgo's holidays
nhve06.caption: Virgo spent the 2016 party at the sink and missed the gift swap entirely. This year the dishes stayed dirty and Virgo stayed on the couch. Which one are you at a party: dancer or dish duty?

nhve07.title: Libra's holidays
nhve07.caption: Libra couldn't pick a gift in 2016, so it bought all six and buried its date in boxes. In 2026 it just asked what would make them feel loved, and wrote the answer down. Revolutionary.

nhve08.title: Scorpio's holidays
nhve08.caption: Scorpio solved the whole secret gift swap in 2016, out loud, in front of everyone. In 2026 it uses the same detective skills to remember the one thing you mentioned in spring. Scary. Romantic.

nhve09.title: Sagittarius' holidays
nhve09.caption: 2016 Sag sent a summit selfie to the family dinner and left an empty chair. 2026 Sag walks in with snowy boots, a bag of stories and someone new to meet. Which one is your Sag this year?
